Notes: Talismans multiply with each other and with every other slot. Never additive.
Two different tears multiply. Same-name doubles are a special case (two Crimson).
Golden Vow spell, ash, and tool share Aura — last one wins, they do not multiply.
Determination and Royal Knight's Resolve overwrite each other.
Exalted Flesh overwrites Flame Grant Me Strength. Multiplies with Aura and Passive.
